findings.reason: the plan must say whether it extends the existing document publisher or why a second one is required, because the two now overlap in directory, atomicity and loop shape.
findings.text: §10 adds `watch_publish.py` as a new standing publisher with its own atomic write (`_write_atomic`), its own cadence loop and its own single-line log, and never mentions `lane.write_lane_document`/`router._publish_lane`, which already publish an atomically-replaced JSON document to the same `~/public/imas-ambix/` directory; a second independent publisher is how the two documents' write semantics (stamp, mode, failure-leaves-previous) drift apart

findings.reason: §4 should extend the existing receipt identity (`run_id`) and state why it cannot carry the serve-side per-caller attribution, rather than introducing a second identity channel and leaving §4's stale premise in the plan text.
findings.text: §4 is built on the premise that "no request receipt has ever been written" and that `caller_hint` is the only candidate identity, yet the plan's own §9 "Rewired 2026-09-29" records the relay restarted 2026-09-26 and the router's `requests.jsonl` now carrying `run_id`/`coordinator_session`, and `cache_estimate.caller_of` already owns the precedence rule (run_id, else coordinator_session); §4 therefore adds a launcher-stamped header as a parallel identity beside one that exists and is already consumed

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — `imas_ambix/agent/live_panel.py` hides the receipt-tail differencing, the cumulative-histogram median, the run-boundary check and the lane-field copy behind `live_panel()`/`live_document()`, and imports `lane.classify_reading` and `serving_receipts.tier_paths` rather than re-implementing them.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §4 proposes a launcher-stamped declared header as a caller identity while the request receipt already carries `run_id`/`coordinator_session`, read through `imas_ambix/agent/cache_estimate.py:71` `caller_of`.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §11 adds `--live` and two published blocks but names the readers it retires in dotfiles and states why `--live` cannot merge into `--json`, and §14 adds one published field and states why nothing can be retired.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §10 introduces a second standing document publisher (`imas_ambix/agent/watch_publish.py`) writing to `~/public/imas-ambix/` without citing the existing lane-document publisher (`imas_ambix/agent/lane.py:650` `write_lane_document`, looped by `imas_ambix/agent/router.py:2045` `_publish_lane`), which already writes an atomically-replaced JSON document in that same directory from the fleet.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the layers the plan adds carry their justification, not bare forwards: §11's `--live` exists to skip the index, and §9's single estimate-record accessor replaces a constant that would otherwise be repeated inside two tools.
